_comment: Layer policies: priority, not partitioning; only membership is generated. Chosen by the S1 template screen (bench/templates/default-slice-1ms.json). scx_layered lets a preempting layer preempt only non-preempting ones, so default must preempt batch or a waking default task waits behind batch hogs, which would make default worse than no scx_layered at all. Short batch and default slices bound the remaining waits.
